editorial_thesis: As agents gain access to the web, tools, and execution environments, the practical edge is a legible boundary between discoverability, delegated authority, human feedback, and portable state.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Web + Runtime Surfaces
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh Cloudflare product signals create a coherent new lane around agent-callable content, delegated access, visibility, and sandboxes; this is materially distinct from yesterday's governance and measurement focus.

sources.title: Cloudflare AI Search reaches general availability
sources.why_selected: Turns web and documentation search into an agent-facing platform surface.
sources.usefulness: Supports an agent-discovery audit for Buildn and client knowledge bases.

sources.title: Cloudflare Containers, rebuilt to scale agent sandboxes
sources.why_selected: Shows runtime design shifting toward disposable, preview-producing agent workloads.
sources.usefulness: Provides a benchmark target for isolated Buildn job execution.

sources.title: The Agent Access Model
sources.why_selected: Frames agent access as scoped delegation rather than copied human credentials.
sources.usefulness: Informs typed job manifests and least-privilege client automation.

sources.title: Trusted agent delegation
sources.why_selected: Extends the access model to chained and delegated actions.
sources.usefulness: Useful for authority-chain UX and revocation design.

sources.title: Personal-agent visibility and control
sources.why_selected: Makes agent visibility and user control an explicit product problem.
sources.usefulness: Suggests a Buildn panel for action rationale, scope, and undo.

topic_groups.title: Human-AI Collaboration Research
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A neglected interaction-design gap: the useful question is not whether AI assists, but when feedback changes human reasoning before errors compound.

sources.title: Think Once, Reflect Twice: How Feedback Shapes Human-AI Collaboration
sources.why_selected: Directly studies feedback and revision in human-AI collaboration.
sources.usefulness: Provides a research anchor for checkpoint and reflection design.

sources.title: Computation and Language recent submissions
sources.why_selected: Current stream provides high-recall signal across AI, language, and security.
sources.usefulness: Supports a lightweight daily paper-triage workflow.

sources.title: Machine Learning recent submissions
sources.why_selected: Fresh methods and evaluation work often surface here before product summaries.
sources.usefulness: Useful for selecting one runnable experiment rather than consuming hype.

sources.title: Networking and Internet Architecture recent submissions
sources.why_selected: Adds systems and infrastructure signal to the interaction lane.
sources.usefulness: Helps connect interface ideas to latency, reliability, and deployment constraints.

topic_groups.title: Local-First Open Tools
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Coverage has been dominated by hosted agent platforms; this lane rotates toward open formats, self-hosting economics, and replaceable workflow cores.

sources.title: Omnara — open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents
sources.why_selected: A current open-source agent harness lead centered on self-hosted execution and model choice.
sources.usefulness: Supports a portability comparison with Hermes and Buildn job contracts.

sources.title: KetchUp open 3D tool
sources.why_selected: Demonstrates an inspectable Rust/WebGPU creative surface discovered in current maker circulation.
sources.usefulness: Offers a reference for browser-native visual artifacts and exportable client handoffs.

sources.title: This Blog Post is Your Sign to Start Self-Hosting
sources.why_selected: Makes the case for selective self-hosting based on current infrastructure conditions.
sources.usefulness: Provides a practical starting point for sovereignty and restore-path decisions.

sources.title: The Self-Hosting Sweet Spot in 2026
sources.why_selected: Adds a risk, cost, and operational-overhead framing rather than ideology.
sources.usefulness: Useful for a Buildn service-boundary matrix.

sources.title: Ask HN: What are you working on? November 2026
sources.why_selected: Current maker thread surfaces emerging local agent workflows and experiments.
sources.usefulness: Good discovery source for tools to inspect, not a substitute for validation.
